To start uncovering your potential, how would you describe your current relationship with physical training and the way you approach competitive effort?
Options: [The pursuit of raw explosive power and velocity. | The disciplined grind of endurance and sustained output. | The technical mastery of precision and tactical movement.]
The pursuit of raw explosive power and velocity.

When you are pushing your body to its absolute limit, what drives your motivation more: the pursuit of personal perfection, or the heat of a direct confrontation?
Options: [The pursuit of perfect movement—honing my craft against time, distance, or gravity. | The heat of the moment—directly outmaneuvering or outperforming an opponent. | The calculated risk—executing high-stakes, complex maneuvers under extreme pressure.]
The heat of the moment—directly outmaneuvering or outperforming an opponent.

As we look at your sporting journey, which environment do you feel best channels that intensity?
Options: [Intense, high-stakes team environments where tactical communication is key. | One-on-one head-to-head scenarios where it is purely you against an opponent. | Dynamic, unpredictable environments where you must constantly react to external chaos.]
One-on-one head-to-head scenarios where it is purely you against an opponent.
